cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && SIDEGRAPH_DIR=.sidegraph SIDEGRAPH_GRAPH=graphify-out/graph.json uvx --from git+https://github.com/SantyagoSeaman/sidegraph.git@main sidegraph-stop || printf '{}\n'
